sections.heading: How to Get Admission in BAMS in Madhya Pradesh

content.text: After passing the 12th board exam with the science stream (PCB Subjects), students looking for BAMS admission must enroll for the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET UG). Qualifying with a score above the cut-off marks in NEET enables a student a higher chance of admission. All the eligible students must attend the MP AYUSH counselling session for admission to the BAMS program. It is conducted by the counselling authority of the Department of AYUSH, Government of Madhya Pradesh. A total of 2643 seats are available for BAMS admission in Madhya Pradesh, out of which 513 are government seats and 2130 are private seats.

sections.heading: BAMS Admission Process in Madhya Pradesh

content.text: A stepwise guide is given below for the students who are willing to take BAMS admission in Madhya Pradesh. It covers the whole procedure, including an overview of the counselling conducted.
Step 1: At first, appear in the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET UG) conducted by the NTA. Score above the cut-off mark to have a higher chance of admission.

Step 2: Next, enrol yourself for the counselling session that is conducted by the Department of AYUSH, Government of Madhya Pradesh. Register on the official website at https://ayush.mponline.gov.in/ to generate login credentials.
Step 3: While registering, submit all of your documents and personal information. Those documents will be verified during the counselling session.
Step 4: Attend the online counselling session during which, choose your preferred colleges.

Step 5: According to the availability of seats and NEET score, you will be allotted to a college. The next procedure will be to report to the exact college within the deadline with the necessary original documents to complete the verification.
Step 6: Lastly, pay the prescribed fees to the allotted college to confirm your admission.

There are 4 rounds of counselling (Round 1, Round 2, Round 3, and the Stray Vacancy Round) conducted in Madhya Pradesh. So, if you’re not allotted seats during the 1st Round, participate in the further rounds.

sections.heading: BAMS Eligibility in Madhya Pradesh

content.text: There is a certain set of eligibility criteria for BAMS admission in Madhya Pradesh. Usually, it is the same as any other state’s eligibility criteria for BAMS. The requirements are mentioned below in detail.

items: Complete the 12th with subjects – Physics, Chemistry, and Biology.
Score an Aggregate of 50% and above in the PCB subjects in the 12th board examination. 10% score relaxation is allowed to the reserved category.
Appear and score above the cut-off mark, in the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET UG).
The candidates must be aged over 17 years at the time of admission.
For admission in the state quota seats, the willing students have to produce the domicile proof of Madhya Pradesh.

content.text: The eligibility for the BAMS course in Madhya Pradesh is that a candidate must have passed the two-year Pre-University or Plus Two or 12th examination or Intermediate or equivalent with Science subjects, obtaining at least 50% aggregate marks in Physics, Chemistry and Biology.
